run_back_translation_training: run the back-translation training loop with BERT encoder and GPT2 decoder using argparse CLI flags
validate_encoder_decoder_model: validate the encoder-decoder model on a dataset and compute accuracy and loss metrics
compute_accuracy_predictions: compute model accuracy by comparing predicted tokens against target tokens excluding BOS
generate_model_name: generate a unique model name string from training arguments including batch size, learning rate, and encoder size
build_inputs_with_special_tokens: build token input sequences by wrapping token IDs with BOS and EOS special tokens
